summary: Generated artifacts for 6 new PayU India checkout acceptance criteria: 3 browser checks (india quote/shipping + PayU hosted redirect, international assisted flow, admin PayU order detail) and 4 backend pytest files (order state protection incl. 404/422/admin-override guard, reconciliation cron auth+idempotency, India shipping-rule quote). Also fixed a regression in shared test helper (helpers_order.py) and one legacy test (test_tscheck_shipping_and_notes_privacy.py) that posted India addresses directly to /order-requests -- now correctly rejected (422) since India must route through PayU; switched them to an international destination so unrelated cancellation/refund/notes/shipping criteria keep working. Full backend suite (40 tests) and all 3 new browser checks pass.

checks.criterion: India checkout shows the server-verified Shopify-equivalent shipping rule
checks.name: india-checkout-payu-redirect
checks.evidence: Added a ₹3,850 approved product to cart, filled valid India address; review step shows India shipping = 'Free' (subtotal >= ₹1,000), product subtotal equals payable total (no shipping added), and 'Pay securely with PayU' button shows the same total. Screenshots: review-step, review-shipping-free.

checks.criterion: India checkout shows the server-verified Shopify-equivalent shipping rule
checks.name: test_tscheck_india_shipping_rule_quote.py
checks.evidence: POST /payments/quote for an approved product (subtotal>=1000) -> 200, shipping_amount=0, total=subtotal+shipping. POST /payments/quote with empty items -> 422 (payable total must be > 0), exercising the zero-shipping/threshold math guard.

checks.criterion: India checkout hands off securely to PayU Hosted Checkout
checks.name: india-checkout-payu-redirect
checks.evidence: Clicking 'Pay securely with PayU · ₹3,850' submitted a hidden POST form and navigated to https://secure.payu.in/_payment (confirmed via page.waitForURL(/secure\.payu\.in|api\.payu\.in/) and final page.url() matching payu.in); PayU's own hosted branding rendered (screenshot payu-hosted-page) with no card/UPI inputs ever rendered on the SAFYRA page itself.

checks.criterion: PayU order state is server protected
checks.name: test_tscheck_payu_order_state_protected.py
checks.evidence: POST /payments/create -> 201 with action=https://secure.payu.in/_payment; GET /payments/{txn} -> 200 status='pending'; admin PATCH /order-requests/{number} {payment_status:Paid,payment_verified:true} -> 409 (PayU payments can only be confirmed by a verified gateway response), confirmed still pending afterward. GET /payments/tscheck-unknown-txn-<rand> -> 404. POST /payments/quote with country_code=US/shipping=international -> 422 (India delivery only).

checks.criterion: International checkout remains assisted rather than entering PayU
checks.name: international-checkout-stays-assisted
checks.evidence: Selecting United States auto-flips shipping to international; review step shows 'Personal shipping confirmation' handoff note, no ₹ payable-total/shipping-total testids render; submit button reads 'Submit international order request'; clicking it reaches checkout-complete with a request reference and final URL does NOT match payu.in.

checks.criterion: Admin can distinguish PayU orders and totals
checks.name: admin-order-shows-payu-gateway-detail
checks.evidence: Created a real PayU order via POST /payments/create (txn SAF5D78DBF12935482CB816, total 3850), logged in as admin, searched by request_number, opened detail: 'admin-order-gateway' section shows provider PayU, merchant transaction id, inventory reservation state; payment-status select is disabled (cannot be manually set to Paid) and the manual-verification checkbox is absent; ₹3,850 total visible.

checks.criterion: PayU reconciliation schedule endpoint is protected and idempotent
checks.name: test_tscheck_payu_reconcile_cron.py
checks.evidence: POST /cron/payu-reconcile with no Authorization -> 401; with wrong Bearer secret -> 401; with correct Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET -> 202 {accepted:true,duplicate:false} returned quickly (actual reconciliation deferred to BackgroundTasks); re-posting the identical run_id -> 202 {accepted:true,duplicate:true} without reprocessing.
